en.summary: Moneta Markets is an international forex and CFD broker with an FCA-authorised UK entity and offshore entities serving other clients.
pros: UK entity Moneta Markets Capital Ltd (FRN 613381) appears as authorised in FCA register data
Choice of MT4, MT5 and proprietary platforms
Company states 10+ years in the industry
cons: The FCA licence applies only to the UK entity; the site states its international entities are not FCA-regulated or covered by FSCS
Other licences (FSCA, Mauritius FSC) were not found on their registers in this review
Leverage of up to 1:1000 is offered via non-UK entities and carries high risk
Minimum deposit could not be confirmed from the broker's own pages
en.body:
## Regulation and safety

Moneta Markets operates through several legal entities. Moneta Markets Capital Ltd (FCA reference 613381) serves UK clients and appears as authorised in FCA register data (checked 2026-11-12). The broker's own legal page states that its international entities are not FCA-regulated and that FCA protections such as the FSCS, the Financial Ombudsman and FCA leverage limits do not apply to them.

The site also lists Moneta Markets (Pty) Ltd (South Africa, FSCA licence 47490), Moneta Markets Trading Limited (Mauritius, FSC GB24203391) and a Saint Lucia company registration. We could not confirm the FSCA or Mauritius entries on the regulators' registers, so they are marked unverified. A UAE entity is described as licensed for introduction and promotion only, not brokerage.

## Trading conditions

The broker advertises raw (PRIME ECN) spreads from 0.0 pips and leverage up to 1:1000 on MT4 and its PRO Trader platform. The company says it has more than ten years of experience but does not publish an exact founding date. Minimum deposit figures differ between third-party sources, so check the live account pages.

## Platforms

MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, PRO Trader 2.0, a mobile AppTrader, a CopyTrader app and web versions of MT4 are listed.

## Who is it for?

UK residents deal with the FCA-authorised entity. Clients elsewhere are served by offshore entities with lighter protections, so check which entity your account is with. High leverage CFD trading carries a high risk of loss.

ja.body:
## 規制と安全性

Moneta Marketsは複数の法人で運営されています。Moneta Markets Capital Ltd（FCA参照番号613381）は英国顧客向けで、FCA登録データで認可済みと表示されています（確認日 2026-11-12）。同社の法的情報ページには、海外法人はFCAの規制対象外で、FSCSや金融オンブズマン、FCAのレバレッジ規制も適用されないと記載されています。

また、南アフリカのMoneta Markets (Pty) Ltd（FSCA 47490）、モーリシャスのMoneta Markets Trading Limited（FSC GB24203391）、セントルシアの会社登録も掲載されていますが、規制当局の登録簿では確認できていないため未確認としています。UAE法人は紹介・販促のみのライセンスとされています。

## 取引条件

Raw（PRIME ECN）スプレッドは0.0pipsから、レバレッジはMT4とPRO Traderで最大1000倍と案内されています。業界経験は10年以上とされていますが、設立年は公開されていません。最低入金額は情報源により異なるため、最新の口座ページをご確認ください。

## 取引プラットフォーム

MetaTrader 4、MetaTrader 5、PRO Trader 2.0、AppTrader、CopyTraderアプリ、MT4ウェブ版が利用できます。

## どんな人に向いているか

英国居住者はFCA認可法人と契約します。それ以外の地域では保護の弱い海外法人となるため、口座の契約法人を必ず確認してください。高レバレッジのCFD取引は損失リスクが高くなります。
